description: This chart illustrates the distribution of labels assigned to abusive language examples, likely representing the types of abuse identified in a dataset. The chart contains ten distinct slices, arranged concentrically in a circular format. Starting from the outermost ring and moving inward, the slices are labeled “Mixed” (light blue), “Negative” (dark blue), “Political” (teal), “Abusive” (yellow), “Sexist” (light green), “Racist” (dark green), “Religious” (yellow-green), “Positive” (orange), “Neutral” (light orange), and a central “Other” category (white). A legend is present, listing each label alongside a corresponding color swatch. Percentage labels are not displayed directly on the slices, but the slices vary in size, appearing to be ordered by decreasing proportion as one moves clockwise around the outer ring. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
